title: B-2 Test Program Set Interface Test Adapters
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8126  AFSC PZIMB
description_text: The 557 software engineering squadron (SWES) has a requirement for the design, testing, purchase, and delivery of Interface Test Adapters (ITAs) for use with the new TITAN receiver on the Common Organizational Level Tester (COLT).
